_meta.description: Arizona well depth statistics by county, used for the fallback (non-parcel) estimates in the Cost to Livable calculator.
_meta.source: Arizona Department of Water Resources — Wells55 registry

fields.n: count of wells with a usable recorded depth
fields.sd: standard deviation of well depth, feet

caveats: This is a hosted extract (University of Arizona GIS), not the full ADWR registry.
The complete Wells55 registry holds roughly 200,000 records; this subset has ~8,900 with usable depths.
Counties with small n (Greenlee n=6, Apache n=27, Graham n=32, La Paz n=33, Yuma n=43) are weak signals.
County averages are a poor guide for any specific parcel. Use the live GWSI radius lookup instead.
